correctness.rationale: For finite strictly-positive-edge rooted ultrametric trees, N labeled individuals of strictly positive species abundances, uniform size-m sampling without replacement and legal a_i>=a_j+2 transfers, each edge/clade with mass u contributes l*f_m(u), f_m(u)=1-C(N-u,m)/C(N,m). On horizontal cuts, sum of these indicators integrates to expected rooted Faith PD. Increment f_m(u+1)-f_m(u)=C(N-u-1,m-1)/C(N,m) is nonincreasing, proving the star-like case (cuts one block or all singletons). For two individuals E=H+[sum_{r<s}a_r a_s d_rs]/[N(N-1)] and its transfer difference has numerator (a_i-a_j-1)d_ij+sum_{k not i,j}a_k(d_jk-d_ik). A nonstar ultrametric has an outgroup i and closer pair j,k, so a_i=3,a_j=1,a_k=M and all others 1 makes the numerator strictly negative for sufficiently large integer M; at m=N-1, the formerly unique j tip stops being omissible, increasing expectation by its positive terminal pendant length divided by N. For N<=5, the only three-species transfer is (3,1,1)->(2,2,1), and every possible clade partition has nonnegative gain; two-species cases are star-like and >=4 species cannot admit a two-unit donor/recipient gap. Thus six is sharp. For 3 tips with a=(3,1,2)->(2,2,2) and cherry length ratio eps, the m=1..6 differences are [0,(2eps-1)/15,(5eps-2)/20,(4eps-1)/15,eps/6,0]; independent labeled-subset enumeration verified eps=1/7,1/3,9/10, including [0,-1/45,-1/60,1/45,1/18,0] at eps=1/3, and independently enumerated all 186 small-census partition comparisons. Recomputed Git tree and inspected the actual checker source; the infinite theorem is analytic, not inferred from finite checks.
residual_risks: No proof of analogous claims for nonultrametric trees, unrooted diversity or nonuniform sampling; none claimed.
No all-sample-depth sign profile classification on an arbitrary nonstar tree is proved; only m=2 versus m=N-1.

The new nonstar construction uses a third-species abundance M to make this negative and an omitted-singleton argument at N-1 to make the same transfer strictly positive; the prior fixed-profile formulas do not assert this sign comparison.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the joint quantified characterization. Nipperess & Matsen (2013) already derive exact hypergeometric edge expectations and their star specialization; Nipperess (2016) already identifies the two-draw phylogenetic-evenness/Rao pairwise-distance connection; Chao et al. (2015) supply further fixed-profile accumulation/estimation. These are credited foundations, not claimed as new. Comparing the actual quantified propositions and deductions in their accessible technical text did not show a star iff all-population abundance-transfer theorem, every-nonstar negative-at-two/positive-at-N-1 witness, or the exact N=6 sharp transfer boundary. Cadotte et al. (2010) bears directly on clade abundance imbalance but could be read only in abstract, and its full technical content is not excluded. The finding is qualified by that and by potentially indexed older equivalent formulations, not a novelty certificate.
residual_risks: Cadotte et al. (2010) has strong same-object relevance, but only abstract and bibliographic material accessible. An authorized Oxford retrieval returned VPN disconnected; no full-document noncoverage is asserted.

An older phrasing in Rao quadratic entropy/majorization, clade imbalance, or urn-model literature could give an equivalent transfer-order characterization; these search negatives are not a novelty certificate.

2012 O’Dwyer et al. microbial sampling paper was not inspected in full; its accessible abstract and the 2013 comparison indicate other sampling models, but buried finite-population results are not excluded.

value.rationale: This addresses the interpretation of greater abundance evenness in phylogenetic rarefaction: species-richness expectation is transfer-monotone, but the amount of sampled evolutionary history depends on relatedness. The precise natural-object boundary is all-equal-tip-distance stars vs every nonstar ultrametric. The two opposing sampling-depth effects under the SAME balancing transfer and the exact N=6/three-species minimal obstruction are reusable structural facts, not a trivial reparametrization, arbitrary numerical slice, or known-table recomputation. The proof provides an explanatory clade aggregation mechanism and minimal witness. It does not assert ecology causation, unknown trees, or all sampling designs.
residual_risks: The exact minimal census of reversal on each fixed nonstar tree is not classified.
Ecological utility is mathematical interpretation of idealized abundance transfers, not field validation.

final_claim: For every finite rooted strictly positive-edge ultrametric tree with at least two species and every positive-integer census, all legal one-individual abundance equalizing transfers weakly increase expected rooted Faith PD for each uniform without-replacement sample size if and only if all distinct tip pairs are equidistant (star-like, possibly after a common stem). On every nonstar, some same transfer decreases E(2) strictly but increases E(N-1) strictly. No such loss occurs at N<=5; an N=6, three-species cherry witness (3,1,2)->(2,2,2) and eps=1/3 has six exact gains [0,-1/45,-1/60,1/45,1/18,0].
limitations: Only positive integer finite abundances, rooted ultrametric positive branches, uniform fixed-size sampling without replacement, one legal transfer.
The constructed reversal concerns existence of some profile per nonstar, not each profile or fixed smallest N per tree.
No new external formal/Lean proof or human expert attestation claimed.
Cadotte 2010 technical text unavailable; best-of-knowledge originality qualified; no bibliographic exclusivity certified.
